bio: I'm a civil engineering student at NITK Surathkal, and I've been shipping software since 2021. It started with Arjun Guruji, a Flutter app I still maintain, which has passed 2,000 downloads. Today I lead the four-person web team building Osdag, an open-source steel design tool, at FOSSEE, IIT Bombay.

Civil engineering teaches you to check the load path before you trust the drawing, and I work on software the same way. Before Osdag's web version went to production, I load-tested it at 200+ concurrent requests with 20+ contributors, then wrote up the server configuration the results supported.
Lately I've been pulled toward data systems: OpenLake, a Spark and Delta Lake platform that runs locally or on Azure from one codebase, and a process-mining backend in Spring Boot.
notes: B.Tech in Civil Engineering with a minor in Electronics & Communication, NITK Surathkal, 2023 to present.
Two third-place hackathon finishes and an ETHGlobal selection.
Looking for SDE and data engineering roles for 2027.
